mortgage_eligibility.horizons_origin: One conditional active entry per facility and design; NOT Task8 first-observation origin
mortgage_eligibility.horizon_interpretation: Observed monthly risk sets use macro known each interval. No future macro path required at entry. Tail support does not authorize prospective forecasts.

existing_api.qualification: Only individual cells passing frozen selector, operand and freshness rules; not universal historical coverage.

fhfa.scope: One paired historical publication snapshot only, knowable no earlier than 2008-08-26; not a complete release chain or certified semantic bridge to frozen USSTHPI versions.

freddie_pmms.finding: Official compiled history includes earlier values, but the bounded investigation did not establish a complete pre2010 date-specific publication/revision chain. This is not proof such releases do not exist.
freddie_pmms.admission: No current compiled history backfill, fixed-lag reconstruction or zero-revision assumption.

march_2026.finding: October 2025 CPS estimates were not collected during the appropriations lapse and were not collected retroactively. Not a later revision or ordinary release lag.
march_2026.treatment: Retain missingness; no interpolation; reporting boundary stays 2026-03 and eligible windows end where frozen operands require.

finalized_validation_design.basis: Structural fixed-effect estimability and frozen support, no performance search
finalized_validation_design.primary_temporal_metric_population: Seen development vintages in evaluation hash role
finalized_validation_design.unseen_temporal_handling: Separate extrapolation sensitivity; unseen vintage effect fixed to zero relative to 2006 reference, flagged UNSEEN_VINTAGE. Never pool with primary temporal metrics.
finalized_validation_design.leave_vintage_out_handling: Held-out vintage coefficient is unestimated, explicitly fixed to zero relative to training 2006 reference. If 2006 is held out, use 2008 training reference. Report restriction and cause/event feasibility for each fold; no learned held-out fixed-effect claim. This tests conditional extrapolation, not an estimated unseen-cohort effect.
finalized_validation_design.uncertainty: Facility and calendar-block dependence; borrower clustering unavailable

source_and_frozen_artifact_checks.ledger_check: Byte hashing against retained public serialization; no consumption API

limitations: Primary cannot evaluate 2007–2009 macro regimes; reduced is one fixed sensitivity only.
Mortgage records are current-release retrospective disclosures; macro PIT does not certify historical mortgage operational knowledge time.
Survival into the support window creates delayed entry and a conditional population; old-vintage survivors are not the full origination cohorts.
Default is a monthly research proxy; payoff includes maturity. Unknown and administrative states censor before unascertainable exposure; censoring independence is not established.
Scheduled first-payment proxy is not exact origination age; provider age remains separate.
Facility disjointness is not borrower disjointness. Monthly rows and macro periods are dependent; prospective validation must account for facility/calendar clustering.
Unrestricted age-period-cohort effects remain unidentified. Future coefficients would be predictive conditional associations, not causal economic effects.
Prior outcomes have been inspected. Future temporal evaluation is prespecified reused research evidence, not a virgin holdout; Task10 needs a new sealed ledger before fitting.
No complete authoritative pre2010 HPI/PMMS release chain admitted. Isolated historical HPI evidence does not extend frozen feature support.
Observed interval support does not provide future macro scenario paths or authorize unsupported tail forecasts, IFRS9 staging or ECL claims.

Earlier development cannot estimate later-vintage fixed effects. Primary temporal metrics must use seen vintages; unseen and held-out vintages require explicitly flagged reference-effect extrapolation sensitivity, never learned unseen-cohort effects.

Mortgage rate, Treasury yield and their spread are algebraically redundant. All eight features remain required for eligibility; Task10 must prespecify an identifiable coefficient constraint/basis before fitting, with no unrestricted three-rate effects.
